name: Azure SQL - QueryStoreWait Stats
description: See information about how much time a database spent waiting on different wait types.
title: Azure SQL - QueryStoreWait Stats

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  "\"operationName\":\"QueryStoreWaitStatisticsEvent\""
| json "LogicalServerName", "SubscriptionId", "ResourceGroup", "resourceId", "category", "operationName", "properties" nodrop
| json field=properties "exec_type", "statement_type", "is_parameterizable", "query_param_type", "wait_category", "ElasticPoolName", "DatabaseName"
| where operationName = "QueryStoreWaitStatisticsEvent"
| concat(LogicalServerName, ":", DatabaseName) as Server_DatabaseName
|where if ("{{resourceid}}" = "*", true, resourceid matches "{{resourceid}}") AND if ("{{subscriptionid}}" = "*", true, subscriptionid matches "{{subscriptionid}}") AND if ("{{operationname}}" = "*", true, operationname matches "{{operationname}}") AND if ("{{elasticpoolname}}" = "*", true, elasticpoolname matches "{{elasticpoolname}}") AND if ("{{exec_type}}" = "*", true, exec_type matches "{{exec_type}}") AND if ("{{statement_type}}" = "*", true, statement_type matches "{{statement_type}}") AND if ("{{logicalservername}}" = "*", true, logicalservername matches "{{logicalservername}}") AND if ("{{wait_category}}" = "*", true, wait_category matches "{{wait_category}}") AND if ("{{query_param_type}}" = "*", true, query_param_type matches "{{query_param_type}}") AND if ("{{resourcegroup}}" = "*", true, resourcegroup matches "{{resourcegroup}}") AND if ("{{is_parameterizable}}" = "*", true, is_parameterizable matches "{{is_parameterizable}}") AND if ("{{category}}" = "*", true, category matches "{{category}}") AND if ("{{databasename}}" = "*", true, databasename matches "{{databasename}}")
|count as eventCount by Server_DatabaseName
| sort by  eventCount, Server_DatabaseName asc

_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  "\"operationName\":\"QueryStoreWaitStatisticsEvent\""
| json "LogicalServerName", "SubscriptionId", "ResourceGroup", "resourceId", "category", "operationName", "properties" nodrop
| json field=properties "exec_type", "statement_type", "is_parameterizable", "query_param_type", "wait_category", "ElasticPoolName", "DatabaseName"
| where operationName = "QueryStoreWaitStatisticsEvent"
| if (exec_type == "0", "Regular", if (exec_type == "3", "Aborted",if (exec_type == "4", "Exception", exec_type))) as exec_type
|where if ("{{resourceid}}" = "*", true, resourceid matches "{{resourceid}}") AND if ("{{subscriptionid}}" = "*", true, subscriptionid matches "{{subscriptionid}}") AND if ("{{operationname}}" = "*", true, operationname matches "{{operationname}}") AND if ("{{elasticpoolname}}" = "*", true, elasticpoolname matches "{{elasticpoolname}}") AND if ("{{exec_type}}" = "*", true, exec_type matches "{{exec_type}}") AND if ("{{statement_type}}" = "*", true, statement_type matches "{{statement_type}}") AND if ("{{logicalservername}}" = "*", true, logicalservername matches "{{logicalservername}}") AND if ("{{wait_category}}" = "*", true, wait_category matches "{{wait_category}}") AND if ("{{query_param_type}}" = "*", true, query_param_type matches "{{query_param_type}}") AND if ("{{resourcegroup}}" = "*", true, resourcegroup matches "{{resourcegroup}}") AND if ("{{is_parameterizable}}" = "*", true, is_parameterizable matches "{{is_parameterizable}}") AND if ("{{category}}" = "*", true, category matches "{{category}}") AND if ("{{databasename}}" = "*", true, databasename matches "{{databasename}}")
|count as eventCount by LogicalServerName, DatabaseName, ElasticPoolName, statement_type, exec_type, is_parameterizable, query_param_type, wait_category
| sort by eventCount, wait_category asc, LogicalServerName, DatabaseName, statement_type, exec_type, is_parameterizable, query_param_type, ElasticPoolName
